description: This file defines the class ExactMatchStreamNamespacePredicate, which implements an interface for stream namespace predicates. It is used to match stream namespaces exactly, likely within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ExactMatchStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: A predicate class that matches a specific stream namespace exactly, used within Orleans.Streams.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a specific target stream namespace.
